character.style: Anime / cel-shaded illustration. Not photorealistic. Clean linework, soft cel shading, subtle volumetric glow on neon elements.
character.build: Athletic young adult male, 6'0" proportions, slim-muscular.
character.hair: Short, tousled, slight quiff. Dark brown. No facial hair.
character.visor: CRITICAL — horizontal LED-strip visor across eyes: a single thin cyan strip (#00D4FF core with soft glow halo). NOT goggles, NOT sunglasses, NOT a helmet visor, NOT a Cyclops/Geordi-style frame. No upper or lower edge visible. Visor is always lit.
character.jacket: Mid-grey bomber/varsity hybrid, geometric panel construction. Stand collar. Cyan AND violet neon piping in angular HEXAGONAL patterns across chest, shoulders, and sleeves — NOT zigzag, NOT racing stripes, NOT diagonals. Rib-knit cuffs and hem in black.
character.shirt: Plain black crew-neck t-shirt under jacket.
character.pants: Slim-fit dark grey trousers. Single cyan + violet piping line down the OUTER leg seam, top to ankle.
character.boots: Black lace-up combat / work boots, mid-ankle.
character.gloves: None for most shots. Optional fingerless black gloves for action shots.
character.description_oneliner: Anime cel-shaded young man with a glowing horizontal cyan LED visor (single strip, no frame), grey bomber jacket with cyan/violet hexagonal neon piping, black tee, dark grey slim pants with side-seam piping, black combat boots.

palette_usage.cyan: dominant accent — visor, jacket piping, all UI accents, lyric highlight color
palette_usage.violet: secondary — piping cross-fades and atmospheric lighting
palette_usage.purple: brand purple — title cards, logo, end cards, ad CTAs

color_grade: Crushed blacks. Lift shadows toward purple/violet.
aesthetic.lighting_cues: Cyan and violet rim lighting. Cinematic, moody, neon-lit. Visor and piping self-illuminate.

always_include_in_image_prompts: preserve character design exactly per the locked spec
crushed blacks, cyan and violet rim lighting

veo_prompt.duration: ~6 seconds, continuous take, locked framing, no cuts, no zooms unless specified
veo_prompt.audio: silent video — no music, no dialogue, no foley, no SFX
style: subtle volumetric glow on neon elements

haze-over-the-horizon.title: Haze over the Horizon
haze-over-the-horizon.environment: Empty asphalt road / highway, foggy purple horizon, distant rising glow, scattered stars above. Pre-dawn.
haze-over-the-horizon.camera: Wide, slow, contemplative. Push-ins. Few or no cuts within a clip.
haze-over-the-horizon.character_action: Standing or walking forward. Back to camera most shots. Singular figure on the road.
haze-over-the-horizon.color_accent: Purple-to-pink horizon, cyan visor, violet ground fog.
haze-over-the-horizon.reference_video: Haze over the Horizon Promo Video.mp4

scatter-brained.title: Scatter Brained
scatter-brained.environment: Rainy nighttime cyberpunk city street. Wet pavement reflections. Neon shop signs. Pedestrians visible but blurred.
scatter-brained.camera: Tracking behind character. Dutch angles okay. Mild handheld feel acceptable.
scatter-brained.character_action: Walking forward, lights blurring past. Occasional digital glitch dissolves on the figure.
scatter-brained.color_accent: Magenta and red neon signage, cyan visor, blue puddle reflections.
scatter-brained.pacing: Faster. 2-3 second average shot length. Glitch cuts every ~4s.
scatter-brained.reference_video: Scatter Brained Lyric Video Promo Vertical.mp4

eat-the-rich.title: Eat the Rich
eat-the-rich.environment: Synthwave grid plane, neon wireframe geometry, score/combo HUD elements, retro arcade visuals.
eat-the-rich.camera: First-person racer / arcade game POV mixed with character reveal shots.
eat-the-rich.character_action: Character appears as the 'pilot' / 'player'. Action-oriented poses.
eat-the-rich.color_accent: Hot pink, cyan, orange — full synthwave palette.
eat-the-rich.reference_video: Eat the Rich Promo - Vertical Tiktok.mp4
